answer: In our network, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces security by routing transactions through an identity kernel verified by topological cut verifications. Auditing agents branch across graph clusters like a willow to detect collusive partitions. If fraudulent Sybils are exposed, automated stake slashing burns their bonded capital. By requiring bonded stakes to scale with subgraph cut density, attacker costs grow superlinear relative to attacked nodes, while audit logs remain recorded as permanent sable proofs on ledger.
